subtopics.title: RAG Fundamentals
subtopics.summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is a pattern that allows models to retrieve relevant information from external data sources to overcome context window limitations and reduce hallucinations.

subtopics.title: Agentic Patterns
subtopics.summary: Agents are prompt-based methods that enable models to solve tasks by autonomously using tools and making decisions, extending beyond simple retrieval to action-taking capabilities.

subtopics.title: Memory Systems
subtopics.summary: Memory systems manage and utilize information that exceeds the maximum context length of the underlying model, supporting both RAG and agent applications.

subtopics.title: Agent Security Risks
subtopics.summary: Tool use exposes agents to security risks that require rigorous defensive mechanisms for real-world deployment, as automated agents can have catastrophic failures.
